acceptance: OEM fuel specification compliance statement for the full range
text: The plant shall operate on the full natural gas range of ALP-OWN-FUL-001 sections 2 to 4: CH4 85.0 to 98.5 mol %, C2H6 up to 7.0 %, C3H8 up to 2.5 %, C4 up to 1.0 %, C5+ up to 0.2 %, N2 up to 4.0 %, CO2 up to 2.5 %, O2 up to 0.02 %; LHV 44.2 MJ/kg to 50.0 MJ/kg (emission limits apply over the whole range; performance guarantees at the reference gas); Wobbe index (GCV) 47.2 MJ/Sm3 to 51.8 MJ/Sm3 with rate of change up to 1 %/min. Hydrogen admixture up to 5 vol % without modification and with all guarantees; provisions for 10 vol % by future OEM retrofit (fuel system materials, gas detection, control system capacity). Reference composition for guarantees: CH4 93.0, C2H6 3.5, C3H8 0.8, i-C4 0.15, n-C4 0.15, C5+ 0.05, N2 1.55, CO2 0.8 mol %; LHV 47.48 MJ/kg (ISO 6976, combustion reference 25 degC, from the reference composition; 34.78 MJ/Sm3 at 15 degC).
title: Natural gas specification
